description: Default Portuguese legal knowledge sources (WS8b), extended to a real crawl policy (WS8c). Values are the ACTUAL tuned production config read read-only from ekoa-dev's runtime state (~/.ekoa/data/knowledge/sources.json) on 2026-08-08, not the stale git-committed ekoa-data/knowledge/sources.seed.json this file superseded - that file's levels/maxPages were pre-tuning defaults and it carried no domino config at all. `id` is each source's REAL upstream id, kept deliberately so a pre-existing crawl ledger on a machine that already ran ekoa-dev's crawler (<dataDir>/knowledge/ledger/<id>.json) is picked up automatically instead of orphaned - see api/src/knowledge/sources-seeder.ts's module doc. Seeded idempotently at boot (keyed by seedId, race-free) under the bootstrap super-admin's org, mirroring api/src/apps/featured-seeder.ts.
